title: Minigame: A8.41 Final Fire by a marked weapon

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the A8.41 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): a German squad, its LMG, a lone leader, and a Gun in the DFPh, Russian squads at ranges 1 and 4, its facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): who may fire in Final Fire, and how, by each weapon's own counter, asked on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: After A9.2's example: a German squad's LMG fired in First Fire and kept no ROF; in the DFPh it may fire again only at an ADJACENT Russian squad.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
